expect.offline: The template ships pinData for Chat Trigger, Project Manager Agent, Write Json, Add Task and Respond Complete (kept verbatim, PROPOSALS P60). In n8n's run every pinned node returns its pin instead of running, so the agent, the JSON writer and the sheet write never run there and every variant ends the same way: Have All Info? takes the pinned 'Yes', and Respond Complete answers with its pinned item.
